A staunch atheist meets a gruesome end and is reincarnated by a capricious entity into the body of an adorable, innocent young girl. Stripped of his old life, he enlists in a ruthless magical military to climb the ranks and wage a personal war against the very God who forced this absurd existence upon him. Armed with lethal tactical genius and unwavering defiance, this petite soldier becomes a terrifying legend on the battlefield, inching closer to her ultimate divine vengeance.
